function.name: create_file
function.description: Create a new file with specified content at a given path.

encoding.description: The encoding of the file. By default 'utf-8'. Only use this parameter if you want to change it to something else.

retrigger.description: This is a meta tool, that allows you, the assistant, to continue working after a tool call. After planning, and executing some tools, you can see the output of the tools and continue performing tasks in the same round. Select if you want to continue the same round after the tool call. You can chose to continute with a new reasoning session to analyze the tools output, have minimal reasoning, just answer directly with no reasoning at all, or not retrigger at all. parameter can only have the following values: '-1': Do not retrigger. '0': No reasoning step, answer directly. '1': Minimal reasoning, quickly think about the tools output. '2': With reasoning, in which you adjust the planning according to the previous tools output.

function.name: self_git_status
function.description: get the status of the current branch inside the internal git. can be used with the normal 'git status' parameters.

parameters.description: parameters given to git status, written chained into a string with spacing. this is the rest of the command you would write in the terminal after git status ..., but is only affecting the internal git
